title: Reflexive verbs and the daily routine: je me lève à sept heures
summary: Me, te, se, nous, vous: the pronoun that matches the subject, and the verbs of a day from se réveiller to se coucher.
focus: Reflexive verbs in the present and the daily routine
content:
## Reflexive verbs: me, te, se…

A reflexive verb carries a pronoun that points back at the subject: **je me lave** = I wash (myself). The infinitive shows **se**: **se laver**, **se lever**. When you conjugate, **se** changes to match the subject:

| subject | pronoun | se laver |
|---|---|---|
| je | me / m' | **je me lave** |
| tu | te / t' | **tu te laves** |
| il / elle / on | se / s' | **il se lave** |
| nous | nous | **nous nous lavons** |
| vous | vous | **vous vous lavez** |
| ils / elles | se / s' | **ils se lavent** |

Before a vowel or a silent **h**, **me**, **te**, **se** become **m'**, **t'**, **s'**: **je m'habille**, **tu t'habilles**, **elle s'habille**. The verb keeps its usual -er endings.

## The routine, from morning to night

- **se réveiller**: to wake up. **Je me réveille à six heures.**
- **se lever**: to get up. **Je me lève à sept heures.** (e → è, as in acheter: **je me lève**, **nous nous levons**)
- **se doucher**: to shower. **Je me douche.**
- **se brosser les dents**: to brush your teeth.
- **s'habiller**: to get dressed. **Je m'habille.**
- **prendre le petit-déjeuner**: to have breakfast. **Je prends le petit-déjeuner.** (not reflexive)
- **rentrer**: to come home. **Je rentre à dix-huit heures.** (not reflexive)
- **se coucher**: to go to bed. **Je me couche à onze heures.**

**Se réveiller** is opening your eyes; **se lever** is getting out of bed. In the drill, the forms come with their reflexive pronoun: **me lève**, **te lèves**, **nous levons**.

## Saying no, and the pronoun before an infinitive

In a negative sentence, the pronoun stays glued to its verb: **ne** goes before the pronoun, **pas** after the verb.

- **Je ne me lève pas.** (I'm not getting up.)
- **Il ne se couche pas tôt.** (He doesn't go to bed early.)
- **Tu ne t'habilles pas ?** (Aren't you getting dressed?)

After **aller**, **aimer** or another verb, the reflexive verb stays in the infinitive, but its pronoun still matches the subject:

- **Je vais me coucher.** (not **se coucher**)
- **Tu vas te doucher ?**
- **Nous allons nous lever tôt.**
- **J'aime me lever tard.**

## Body parts and à quelle heure ?

With a body part, French says **le**, **la**, **les**, not **mon**, **ma**, **mes**: the pronoun already tells you whose hands they are.

- **Je me lave les mains.** (I wash my hands.)
- **Elle se brosse les dents.** (She brushes her teeth.)
- **Tu te laves les cheveux ?** (Are you washing your hair?)

To ask when, use **à quelle heure ?**, at the start or, in speech, at the end:

- **À quelle heure est-ce que tu te lèves ? — Je me lève à sept heures.**
- **Vous vous couchez à quelle heure ? — À onze heures et demie.**

Nous nous levons tôt pour travailler.

vocabulary.example_meaning: The children wash their hands before the meal.

vocabulary.example: Il se brosse les dents après le petit-déjeuner.

She gets dressed quickly in the morning.

vocabulary.example_meaning: I have breakfast with my sister.

vocabulary.meaning: to come home, to go back

vocabulary.example_meaning: My father comes home from work at 6 p.m.

vocabulary.example_meaning: The baker goes to bed very early.

vocabulary.example_meaning: What time do you wake up?

quiz.prompt: Tu ___ dans ta chambre. (You get dressed in your room.)
quiz.explanation: S'habiller starts with a silent h, so te becomes t': tu t'habilles.
hints: Te before a vowel or silent h?

quiz.prompt: Nous ___ à onze heures. (We go to bed at eleven: se coucher.)
quiz.explanation: With nous, the reflexive pronoun is nous too, so nous appears twice: nous nous couchons.
hints: The pronoun for nous is nous.

options: Je ne me lève pas tôt.
Je me ne lève pas tôt.
Je ne lève me pas tôt.
quiz.correct_answer: Je ne me lève pas tôt.
quiz.explanation: Ne goes before the pronoun and pas after the verb; the pronoun and the verb stay together: je ne me lève pas tôt.
hints: Do not split me from lève.

quiz.prompt: Je vais ___ coucher ce soir. (I'm going to go to bed this evening.)
quiz.explanation: Before an infinitive, the reflexive pronoun still matches the subject: je vais me coucher, not se coucher.
With a body part, French uses les, not ses: the pronoun se already says whose hands. Elle se lave les mains.
hints: Mon, ma, mes are not used with a body part here.

quiz.prompt: 'Nous allons nous lever tôt' is correct: before the infinitive, the pronoun matches nous.
quiz.explanation: Right: the pronoun before an infinitive matches the subject, so nous allons nous lever.

quiz.prompt: ___ tu te lèves ? — À sept heures et quart.
quiz.explanation: The answer is a clock time, so the question is à quelle heure (at what time).

quiz.prompt: Which verb is the moment you open your eyes, before you get out of bed?
quiz.explanation: Se réveiller is waking up; se lever is getting out of bed; se coucher is going to bed.
hints: You can wake up and stay in bed.

quiz.prompt: Prendre le petit-déjeuner is reflexive, so you say 'je me prends le petit-déjeuner'.
quiz.explanation: Prendre le petit-déjeuner is not reflexive: je prends le petit-déjeuner. Only verbs with se in the infinitive take the pronoun.
hints: Is there a se in the infinitive?

listening.meaning: My parents never go to bed before midnight.

listening.meaning: The children shower in the evening after dinner.

listening.text: Le matin, je m'habille vite parce que le bus passe à huit heures.
listening.meaning: In the morning I get dressed quickly because the bus comes at eight.

concept.title: Se lever: the boot again
concept.markdown: **Se lever** follows the e → è pattern you met with **acheter**: the accent appears where the ending is silent. **Je me lève**, **tu te lèves**, **ils se lèvent**, but **nous nous levons**, **vous vous levez**. Listen: the è sounds open, the plain e is almost silent.

guide.tip: Say the pronoun and the verb as one word: memelève, tetelèves. Then ne … pas wraps the whole block, and aller + infinitive keeps it whole too.

conversations.title: Who gets the bathroom?
conversations.scenario: Inès and Hugo have just moved into a flat with one bathroom. They sort out their mornings.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Hugo, à quelle heure est-ce que tu te lèves le matin ?
lines.meaning: Hugo, what time do you get up in the morning?

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Je me réveille à six heures, mais je ne me lève pas tout de suite.
lines.meaning: I wake up at six, but I don't get up straight away.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Ah bon ? Et tu te douches à quelle heure ?
lines.meaning: Really? And what time do you shower?

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Vers sept heures. Je me douche et je m'habille en dix minutes.
lines.meaning: Around seven. I shower and get dressed in ten minutes.
lines.note: m' before the silent h of habille

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Moi aussi, je me douche à sept heures ! Il y a un problème.
lines.meaning: Me too, I shower at seven! There's a problem.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Pas de problème : tu te laves d'abord, et moi, je prends le petit-déjeuner.
lines.meaning: No problem: you wash first, and I have breakfast.
lines.note: prendre le petit-déjeuner is not reflexive

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Super. Et le soir, tu te couches tard ?
lines.meaning: Great. And in the evening, do you go to bed late?

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Non, je me couche à dix heures et demie. Je suis toujours fatigué !
lines.meaning: No, I go to bed at half past ten. I'm always tired!

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Moi, je rentre tard, alors je vais me coucher vers minuit.
lines.meaning: I get home late, so I'm going to go to bed around midnight.
lines.note: me matches je before the infinitive

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: D'accord. Alors bonne nuit, Inès, et à demain matin !
lines.meaning: OK. Good night then, Inès, and see you tomorrow morning!

bites.title: The pronoun points back
bites.rule: A reflexive verb carries a pronoun that matches the subject: je me, tu te, il se, nous nous, vous vous, ils se. Before a vowel: m', t', s'.
bites.example: Je m'habille et tu te laves.
bites.example_meaning: I get dressed and you wash.

bites.title: Morning to night
bites.rule: Se réveiller, se lever, se doucher, s'habiller, prendre le petit-déjeuner, rentrer, se coucher. Only the verbs with se take the pronoun.
bites.example: Je me réveille, puis je me lève.
bites.example_meaning: I wake up, then I get up.

bites.title: Keep the block together
bites.rule: Ne before the pronoun, pas after the verb: je ne me lève pas. Before an infinitive, the pronoun matches the subject: je vais me coucher.
bites.example: Il ne se couche pas tard.
bites.example_meaning: He doesn't go to bed late.

bites.title: Les mains, not mes mains
bites.rule: With a body part, use le / la / les: the reflexive pronoun already says whose. Je me lave les mains.

sorts.title: Which pronoun?
sorts.why: The pronoun follows the subject: je → me, tu → te, il / elle / ils → se, with m', t', s' before a vowel or silent h.

sorts.title: Reflexive or not?
sorts.why: Only the verbs whose infinitive has se take a reflexive pronoun; rentrer and prendre le petit-déjeuner do not.

sorts.title: Morning or evening?
sorts.why: The day starts with se réveiller and se lever and ends with rentrer and se coucher.

spots.sentence: Je me habille dans ma chambre.
spots.why: Me becomes m' before the silent h of habille: je m'habille.

spots.sentence: Nous se levons à sept heures.
spots.why: With nous, the reflexive pronoun is nous: nous nous levons.
Before an infinitive the pronoun still matches the subject: je vais me coucher.
With a body part, use les: elle se lave les mains.

spots.sentence: Mes parents se couche à minuit.
spots.why: Mes parents = ils, which takes -ent: ils se couchent.

builds.text: Je me lève à sept heures.
Je ne me couche pas tard.
builds.meaning: I don't go to bed late.
